plain: The refusal to fight back against force or authority.

webster.text: The omission of resistance; passive obedience; submission to authority, power or usurpation without opposition.

example.quote: The reasons adduced here to-day have long ago been advanced in favor of passive obedience and non-resistance.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 14, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
